title: Nourishing Smoky Canadian Noodles
description: A smoky and chewy Canadian dish featuring Thai chilli jam, served on a slate tile, this quick-fix noodle recipe is egg-free friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
While the noodles are cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the Thai chilli jam and soy sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the pasta water to the skillet and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain the cooked noodles and add them to the skillet, tossing to combine with the sauce.
Transfer the noodles to a slate tile and top with sesame seeds and chopped scallions.
